policy_extraction.implementation_notes: Launched in February 2026 by NIST / Center for AI Standards and Innovation (CAISI) in collaboration with NCCoE and NSF (under the post-EO 14434 'Super Intelligence (SI)' portal nomenclature). This overview establishes a voluntary, industry-led standardization program for autonomous AI/SI agents centered on interoperable open protocols, agent identity, authentication, authorization, open-source ecosystem security, and security evaluations, with stakeholder consultation milestones in March–April 2026 and no regulatory mandates.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: The NIST CAISI SI Agent Standards Initiative is dominantly framed around innovation_enablement, seeking to catalyze widespread, confident adoption of autonomous agents through voluntary industry-led standards, open interoperable protocols, and sector-specific barrier reduction in healthcare, finance, and education. Innovation_enablement edges out economic_competitiveness because the operational pillars center on reducing ecosystem friction and building interoperable voluntary standards rather than zero-sum trade competition. Economic_competitiveness is a notable secondary frame via explicit goals of cementing U.S. dominance at the technological frontier and maintaining international standards leadership, while consumer_public_safety appears through secure human-agent interactions, agent threat mitigations, and security evaluations for consumer comparison.

evidence_spans.quote: The Super Intelligence (SI) Agent Standards Initiative ensures that the next generation of SI—agents capable of autonomous actions—is widely adopted with confidence.
evidence_spans.source_section: Ensuring a Trusted, Interoperable, and Secure Agentic Frontier

evidence_spans.quote: NIST engages with the SI ecosystem to identify and reduce barriers to interoperable agent protocols.

By fostering industry-led technical standards and open protocols, NIST aims to catalyze an ecosystem where agents function securely on behalf of users and interoperate smoothly across the digital landscape while cementing U.S. dominance at the technological frontier.
